title: The Lavender and Gold New Year's Eve Dinner Table
description: A lavender and gold New Year's Eve dinner table from Amazon: purple vintage embossed goblets, a dusty purple velvet runner, gold beaded charger plates, gold flatware, scalloped lavender-edge napkins and gold glitter noisemakers for midnight.
intro: Every year I say we're doing a fancy New Year's Eve dinner, and every year we eat pizza off paper plates at 11:58. Not this time. Purple vintage goblets, a velvet runner that looks way more expensive than it is, gold chargers and gold flatware, scalloped napkins with the cutest lavender edge, and a pile of glitter noisemakers for the countdown. My cat already tried to sit on the runner. Twice.

sections.heading: The table
paragraphs: A dusty purple velvet runner (20 x 120 in) down the middle, 13 inch gold beaded chargers at every seat, white cotton napkins with a scalloped lavender edge folded on top, and gold forks, knives and spoons on each side.

sections.heading: The sparkly bits
paragraphs: Purple embossed vintage goblets (10 oz, 6.7 in tall) that catch the light like crazy, plus gold glitter fringed noisemakers, one on every napkin, so midnight actually sounds like midnight.
